extensions.name: Sessions overview
extensions.description: A dashboard tab with every session and seat at a glance. Also a minimal example of an extension tab.

extensions.name: Steam Big Picture on start
extensions.description: Opens Steam in Big Picture mode when a streaming session starts, if Steam is installed.

extensions.name: RDPAutoPatch (multi-RDP)
extensions.description: Keeps the Remote Desktop service patched with TermWrap so Windows client editions accept several RDP sessions at once, with automatic fallback to Windows' termsrv.dll.
extensions.notice: Not part of OpenStreamMS. The Windows client license doesn't allow several remote sessions at once; the supported route is Windows Server with the RDS role and user CALs. Installing it is your own responsibility.
